BILVYAPAR.NS.d: BIL Vyapar Limited currently has no significant operating activity. It once provided media and publication services. Founded in 1872 and based in Mumbai, it was formerly Binani Industries Limited and took its current name in June 2025.

CGVAK.NS.d: CG-VAK Software and Exports Limited is an Indian company involved in IT services and solutions. The company offers software development, IT consulting, and export services. The company is based in India.

CINEVISTA.NS.d: Cinevista Limited produces serials, films, and ad films in India and internationally. It offers commercial television content in the areas of action, adventure, kids programming, drama, and soap; produces and distributes movies; and produces advertising commercials for various clients and advertisers.

EMMVEE.NS.d: Emmvee Photovoltaic Power Ltd. manufactures solar photovoltaic modules and solar cells. It operates through Photovoltaics Modules, EPC and Others segments. The modules segment makes and sells photovoltaic modules and systems, and the EPC segment handles engineering, procurement and construction projects in the solar sector.

ENGINERSIN.NS.d: Engineers India Limited, an engineering consultancy company, provides design, engineering, procurement, construction, and integrated project management services primarily for oil and gas, and petrochemical industries in India and internationally. The company operates in two segments, Consultancy & Engineering Projects, and Turnkey Projects.

FELIX.NS.d: Felix Industries Ltd. specializes in comprehensive environmental solutions, with a primary focus on water management. The company's operations are distinctly structured into three core divisions: Water and Wastewater Management, Solid Waste Management, and Hydrocarbon Recycling. The Water and Wastewater Management division delivers holistic, end-to-end services aimed at recovering, purifying, and facilitating the sustainable reuse of water for both industrial and municipal applications.

GALAXYSURF.NS.d: Galaxy Surfactants Limited manufactures and markets specialty chemicals for personal and home care industries in India and internationally. The company offers surfactants, mild surfactants, rheology modifiers, pearlizing agents, syndet and soap bases, UV filters, and active ingredients, as well as conditioning agents, blends, proteins, and quats. It serves the skin, hair, sun, oral, baby, and home care markets. The company was founded in 1980 and is based in Navi Mumbai, India.

GRINFRA.NS.d: G R Infraprojects Limited and its subsidiaries provide engineering, procurement and construction (EPC) services, mainly for roads and highways, in India and abroad. It reports three segments: EPC, Built-Operate-Transfer (BOT) projects, and other related services.

GVT&D.NS.d: GE Vernova T&D India Limited, founded in 1957 in Noida and a subsidiary of Grid Equipments Private Limited, builds power transmission and distribution infrastructure in India and abroad. Its equipment includes HVDC and FACTS power electronics, transformers, circuit breakers, substations, switchgear, capacitors, reactors and control panels, and it also offers turnkey solutions.

HCG.NS.d: HealthCare Global Enterprises Limited, together with its subsidiaries, provides healthcare services focusing on cancer. The company offers cancer diagnosis and treatment services through radiation therapy, medical oncology, and surgery; and fertility treatment services, as well as reproductive medicine services, including assisted reproduction, gynecological endoscopy, and fertility preservation under the Milann brand.

ICICIAMC.NS.d: ICICI Prudential Asset Management Company Limited is an asset manager that runs mutual funds and alternative funds and provides advisory and portfolio management services for offshore clients. It also offers savings and investment products across financial asset classes for individual and institutional investors with varying objectives and risk appetites.

IL&FSTRANS.NS.d: IL&FS Transportation Networks Limited develops, runs and maintains transportation infrastructure in India and abroad, including highways, flyovers, bridges, metro rail, city buses and border check posts. It also handles operation, maintenance and toll collection. Incorporated in 2000 and based in Mumbai, it is owned by Infrastructure Leasing and Financial Services Limited.

IREDA.NS.d: Indian Renewable Energy Development Agency Limited is a non-banking financial company providing financial products and services for renewable energy and energy efficiency in India. It promotes and finances projects based on new and renewable energy sources and energy conservation, and also produces power from solar, wind, hydro and biomass sources and from waste.

IRMENERGY.NS.d: IRM Energy Limited is an Indian company that develops, manages and expands city natural gas distribution networks. It operates in specific areas including Banaskantha, Fatehgarh Sahib, Diu and Gir Somnath, and Namakkal and Tiruchirappalli, supplying industrial, commercial, domestic and vehicle customers.

IVC.NS.d: IL&FS Investment Managers Limited is the private equity, venture capital, and real estate investment arm of Infrastructure Leasing & Financial Services Limited. The firm specializes in seed capital, late venture, growth capital, expansions, middle market, restructuring, stressed assets, recapitalizations, buyouts investments, and real estate investments in high-growth real estate assets including office, residential, retail, integrated townships, special economic zones, hospitality, and mixed-use properties.

JGCHEM.NS.d: J.G. Chemicals Limited, established in 1975 and based in Kolkata, is an Indian company that mainly produces and supplies zinc oxide. Its customers span animal feed, oil and gas, lubricants, fertilisers, agro-chemicals, batteries, electronics, cosmetics, pharmaceuticals, paints and coatings, ceramics and rubber.

KAMAHOLD.NS.d: KAMA Holdings Limited is a holding company with investments in various industries, including chemicals, packaging, and real estate. The company's investments include SRF Limited. The company is located in India.

LANDMARK.NS.d: Landmark Cars Limited operates in automotive retail in India as a dealer for brands including Honda, Mercedes-Benz, Renault, Jeep, Volkswagen, Kia and Mahindra. It sells car accessories and provides pre-sales consultation, after-sales support, roadside assistance, insurance and financing. Founded in 1998, it is based in Mumbai.

LINCPEN.NS.d: Linc Pen & Plastics Limited manufactures and markets writing instruments and stationery products in India and internationally. The company offers gel, ball, retractable ball, and fountain pens; whiteboard, permanent board, and DVD/CD/OHP markers/hi-lighters; pencils; and files and folders under the Linc brand. It also imports, markets, and distributes Uniball products. Linc Pen & Plastics Limited was founded in 1976 and is headquartered in Kolkata, India.

MANORG.NS.d: Mangalam Organics Limited and its subsidiaries make and sell chemicals aimed at industrial and consumer users in India and abroad. Its terpene products include pine tar, camphor oil, terpineol, isoborneol, dipentene, camphene and camphor, and its resin products include terpene and alkyl phenolic resins.

MODINATUR.NS.d: Modi Naturals Limited is an Indian company engaged in the manufacturing and marketing of edible oils, food products, and personal care products. Their product portfolio includes brands like Oleev, Rizolo, and Pipo. The company is based in New Delhi, India.

MUKTAARTS.NS.d: Mukta Arts Limited engages in the production, distribution, and exhibition of films in India. It operates through five segments: Software Division, Equipment Division, Education, Theatrical Exhibition Division, and Others. The Software Division segment is involved in film/TV production and distribution operations. This segment produces/co-produces movies and television content, as well as offers related services; and acquires movie rights for overseas and Indian distribution.

NATCAPSUQ.NS.d: Natural Capsules Ltd. makes and distributes capsule shells of cellulose and hard gelatin in India and abroad. Its gelatin variants include halal-certified, SLS-free, shiny and BSE/TSE-free capsules.

PARKHOTELS.NS.d: Apeejay Surrendra Park Hotels Limited (ASPHL), founded in 1987 and headquartered in New Delhi, owns and manages hotels across India under brands including THE PARK, THE PARK Collection and Zone by The Park. It also runs Flurys confectionery outlets and offers yachts for tourism. Its former name was Budget Hotels, changed in March 2004.

PARSVNATH.NS.d: Parsvnath Developers Limited engages in the real estate development business in India. It promotes, constructs, and develops integrated townships, residential and commercial complexes, multistoried buildings, flats, houses, apartments, shopping malls, IT parks, hotels, special economic zones, etc. The company was incorporated in 1990 and is based in New Delhi, India.

RACE.NS.d: Race Eco Chain Limited trades in and promotes textile products, covering fabrics and yarns for home furnishing uses such as bedding, window dressings, cushions, table coverings and kitchen textiles. Its operations are arranged in three divisions.

RAMCOIND.NS.d: Ramco Industries Limited engages in the building product, textile, and power generation businesses in India. It offers fiber cement roofing sheets and calcium silicate boards; and various accessories and metal framing products. The company also provides design and material consultancy, project execution, site quality assurance, and dry construction methods training services; and invests in securities.

RELIANCE.NS.d: Reliance Industries Limited engages in the hydrocarbon exploration and production, petroleum refining and marketing, petrochemicals, retail, digital, and financial services worldwide. The company produces and markets petroleum products, such as liquefied petroleum gas, propylene, naphtha, gasoline, jet/aviation turbine fuel, kerosene oil, diesel, sulphur, petroleum coke, and alkylate.

SCANSTL.NS.d: Scan Steels Limited is a company listed on the National Stock Exchange of India under the ticker SCANSTL and traded in INR. Its country is India.

SHANKARA.NS.d: Shankara Building Products Limited operates as a retailer of home improvement and building products in India. It operates through Retail, and Channel & Enterprise segments. The company offers structural steel products, cement, TMT bars, hollow blocks, pipes and tubes, roofing solutions, welding accessories, primers, solar heaters, plumbing products, tiles, sanitary ware, water tanks, plywood, kitchen sinks, and lighting and other allied products.

SHINDL.NS.d: Sharat Industries Limited is an Indian company engaged in the manufacture and export of textiles, primarily cotton yarn. The company operates manufacturing facilities and caters to both domestic and international markets. The company is headquartered in India.

SMCGLOBAL.NS.d: SMC Global Securities Limited, together with its subsidiaries, provides various financial services in India and internationally. The company operates through three segments: Trading and Distribution, Advisory, and Financing.

SOLEX.NS.d: Solex Energy Ltd. makes and sells solar photovoltaic (PV) panels in India and provides end-to-end solar solutions, including EPC (engineering, procurement and construction) services. Its portfolio includes solar water pumping systems and complete solar power plants, among them large utility plants mounted on the ground.

SPCL.NS.d: Shivalic Power Control Ltd. operates as an ISO-certified manufacturer of electrical power distribution and control systems. The company specializes in the production of low tension (LT) and high tension (HT) electrical panels, offering a comprehensive range of products including Power Control Center (PCC), Motor Control Center (MCC), Intelligent Motor Control Center (IMCC), and Programmable Logic Controller (PLC) panels, alongside DG synchronization panels, outdoor panels, VFD panels, and Automatic Power Factor…

STINDIA.NS.d: STI India Limited manufactures and sells spun yarns and knitted grey fabrics in India. Its products include organic cotton and blended, BCI cotton, fairtrade cotton, viscose and blended, linen blended, EliTwist, TFO, neppy, slub, core spun, special fiber, high twist, and fancy yarns; and single jersey, rib, pique, 3-thread fleece, and fancy knitted fabrics. The company was incorporated in 1984 and is based in Indore, India. STI India Limited is a subsidiary of Bombay Rayon Fashions Limited.

SUTLEJTEX.NS.d: Sutlej Textiles and Industries Limited manufactures and sells yarns and home textiles in India. It operates through two segments, Yarn and Home Textiles.

SUYOG.NS.d: Suyog Telematics Ltd. provides passive infrastructure for the telecommunications sector in India, supporting internet service providers and telecom operators. Its offerings include fibre optic cable networks, smart poles, rooftop installations and towers mounted on the ground, plus specialised tower types such as Ground-Based Mast and Cells on Wheels.

SWISSMLTRY.NS.d: Swiss Military Consumer Goods Limited is a company listed on the National Stock Exchange of India under the ticker SWISSMLTRY and traded in INR. Its country is India.

TIL.NS.d: TIL Limited manufactures and markets a range of material handling, lifting, port, and road construction equipment in India and internationally. Its products include rough terrain cranes, truck and truck mounted cranes, pick and carry cranes, Manitowoc crawler cranes and grove cranes, reach stackers, forklift trucks, container handlers, crushing and screening stationary plant solutions, crushing and screening wheel mounted solutions, and crushing and screening track mounted solutions, as well as unit equipment,…

TRITURBINE.NS.d: Triveni Turbine Limited manufactures and sells industrial steam turbines in India. The company offers back-pressure and condensing steam turbines for a range of pressure and flow applications, as well as a suite of integrated solutions, such as erection and commissioning, spare parts, operations and maintenance, refurbishing, and other services. It also engages in the trading of steam turbines.

TRIVENI.NS.d: Triveni Engineering & Industries Limited engages in the sugar and engineering businesses in India and internationally. The company manufactures and sells white crystal sugar for multinational beverage, food, and fast moving consumer goods (FMCG) companies; pharmaceutical companies; and confectionery producers, as well as offers sugar under the Shagun brand.

UMESLTD.NS.d: Usha Martin Education & Solutions Limited provides educational support services in India. It operates training centers for various higher education courses under the Usha Martin Academy brand name. The company also offers education services related to Hybris omni-channel and commerce solutions, and courses on big data analytics; and provides SAP global certification courses, as well as career development programs.
